ideas.pitch: An AI-powered smart waste bin classification system built for school environments to encourage recycling.
ideas.title: Smart Campus Waste Sorter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven winning pattern from similar hardware-software youth hackathons (like the TechnoMorph garbage classifier) combined with clear real-world impact for school campuses.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision mobile app that analyzes student physical education postures like pushups and squats using device cameras.
ideas.title: PoseFit School Sports Trainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a live-working demo with MediaPipe that school judges and industry mentors can immediately test on their own phones during the 5-minute pitch.

ideas.pitch: A localized energy tracking and gamified carbon reduction dashboard designed specifically for high school classrooms.
ideas.title: EcoSchool Energy & Carbon Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the judging criteria of Real-World Impact by solving a tangible electricity wastage issue in institutional buildings.

ideas.pitch: A personalized multi-agent tutoring platform trained on high school board syllabus textbooks and sample papers.
ideas.title: EduAgent RAG Study Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced technical feasibility by integrating local retrieval-augmented generation for high school level academic help.

ideas.pitch: A mobile web app providing school students with safe walking routes and real-time crowdfunded hazard reports.
ideas.title: SafeRoute School Commute Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Hits high on the Real-World Impact and Presentation judging criteria by solving safety concerns for students commuting to school.
